title: Social Media Manager/ Digital Marketing Specialist
Social Media Marketing Internship in Noida, Delhi, Faridabad (Hybrid)
Social Media Marketing Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 Beyond Tara is an Indian fashion label launched in 2023 that focuses on ready\-to\-wear clothing for women. The brand is known for bold colors, graphic prints, and its signature \#Taraprints that bring vibrance and fun to everyday style. Beyond Tara emphasizes simple yet stylish silhouettes that are elevated by unique, artful prints. The team celebrates creativity and individuality, offering a dynamic environment for professionals interested in fashion, design, and brand storytelling.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time hybrid Social Media Marketing Intern role based in Faridabad, with some flexibility for work from home. The intern will support day\-to\-day social media activities, including planning, creating, and scheduling content across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant channels. They will assist in engaging with the online community through comments, messages, and collaborations, helping to strengthen brand presence and awareness. The role includes monitoring trends, tracking performance metrics, and contributing ideas for campaigns that highlight Beyond Tara’s collections and brand philosophy. The intern will work closely with the marketing and design teams to ensure consistent visual and written storytelling aligned with the brand’s identity.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess skills in Social Media Marketing and Social Media Content Creation.
* Candidates should possess skills in Digital Marketing and Marketing.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Interest in fashion, trends, and visual storytelling; familiarity with platforms like Instagram and Reels is beneficial.
* Basic knowledge of design or content tools (e.g., Canva, simple video editing) is a plus.
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup from Faridabad, manage time effectively, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Pursuing or completed studies in Marketing, Communications, Fashion, or related fields is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Marketing Communication Assistant
description:
**Company Description** 
 Entrepreneur has been a leading resource for business owners since 1973, offering practical guidance on the diverse challenges of entrepreneurship. The magazine and its global editions provide inspirational and informational content that helps readers overcome obstacles and grow their businesses. Published 12 times a year and available in multiple countries, Entrepreneur connects a worldwide community of entrepreneurs and business leaders. Entrepreneur.com, marking over 18 years online, has become a widely used small business website, delivering relevant content, intuitive information organization, and an accessible user experience for its visitors.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Marketing Communication Assistant is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Faridabad. In this position, the individual will support the development and execution of marketing communication campaigns across print, digital, and social channels. Day\-to\-day tasks include drafting and editing marketing copy, coordinating with internal teams to ensure message consistency, and assisting with the planning and organization of promotional activities. The role also involves maintaining marketing materials, tracking campaign performance, and helping the sales and marketing teams with presentations and customer\-facing communication. The assistant will contribute creative ideas, manage basic administrative tasks related to marketing projects, and ensure all communications align with brand guidelines.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Organization Skills to manage information, coordinate tasks, and support cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess Creativity Skills to contribute ideas for campaigns and produce engaging, audience\-focused content.
* Candidates should possess Marketing Communications and Sales skills to assist in crafting persuasive messages and support promotional and sales initiatives.
* Relevant qualifications such as a degree or diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Proficiency in basic office and collaboration tools (e.g., word processing, presentations, spreadsheets) and familiarity with digital and social media platforms.
* Ability to work on\-site in Faridabad, manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Prior internship or work experience in marketing or communications is an advantage.
